reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 32. Nay or No: 6. Not Voting: 2. Of 38 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 37 (97%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 211 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

finance.disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
finance.cycle_rule: House filings use the 2026 two-year cycle.
finance.scope_note: Figures are committee receipts and itemized Schedule A for this two-year cycle only. This is not career fundraising. Schedule E outside spending is not included.
finance.contributor_note: Itemized Schedule A receipts for this principal campaign committee and cycle, grouped by contributor name. Memo lines are omitted so an earmark is not counted twice. Unitemized donations are not in this list. Not every Schedule A row was retrieved, so this ranking uses the largest receipts returned and can miss contributors whose gifts are smaller but add up.

running.label: Candidates who filed with the FEC for this seat. Filing is not the same as being on the ballot. Primary results and ballot access are not shown.
incumbent_notes: Wesley Hunt has a 2026 filing for this seat (FEC H0TX07170, FEC lists: Incumbent), but the FEC marks that candidate inactive. Not counted below.

donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. Employer means where the donor works, not that the company gave money; corporations can't give directly to campaigns. Industry groups use simple keyword rules and may misclassify some donors.
donor_industry.cycle_rule: House filings use the 2026 two-year cycle.

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.
stands_for.scope: House roll calls 1–323 of 2026 (323 votes, January 6, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the House Clerk.
stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.
stands_for.factual_flag: Not yet summarized: this line is built only from the official vote question and the bill's official title.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
🚨 Somali gangs are conquering parts of Minnesota.

We’re seeing rampant crime, violence, and chaos in Minneapolis while Democrats scream “racist” at anyone who notices. 

This isn’t “diversity.” It’s a failure of leadership and open borders that imported unvetted populations who refuse to assimilate. 

Minnesota families are paying the price for feckless leadership.

Enforce the law.

🚨President Trump’s Anti-Fraud Task Force is financially saving our country.

A specialized subdivision focused on fighting fraud in America is getting the job done and protecting our taxpayer dollars. 

No more “business as usual”  with waste, fraud, and abuse. https://t.co/XMg5o6ob73

🚨The new mouthpiece of the Democrat Party: DSA are actively working to abolish sovereign borders, the police, SCOTUS and the Electoral College.

Just listen to them in their own words. https://t.co/6BF5oJGrUW

President Trump is taking decisive action to crack down on illegal immigrants obtaining CDL driver’s licenses. 

After years of the Biden administration’s soft-on-crime policies, which have endangered American lives, Trump has made safeguarding citizens his top priority. 

Radical left states that enable illegal immigrants, many who don’t speak English, to acquire these licenses are choosing to protect those who have broken federal law. 

It is unacceptable and President Trump is determined to put an end to it.

🚨Texas hospital caught advertising 'birth packages' right on the southern border.

$3,950 for a natural birth and…citizenship included?

This is straight-up exploitation of the 14th Amendment. 

The amendment intended to protect the children of freed slaves after the Civil War, is now being used to hand out citizenship to birth tourists.

Happy Independence Day, America! 🇺🇸

250 years ago, brave patriots pledged their lives, and their fortunes, to declare that we are a free people under God, not subjects of a distant tyrant. 

They risked everything so that we could live in the greatest nation the world has ever known.

Our flag has been carried into battle by heroes, draped over the caskets of the fallen, and raised high by every generation that refused to bow to tyranny.

Today, we don’t just celebrate fireworks and cookouts. We honor the eternal truth that freedom isn’t free. 

God bless the United States of America.

We’ve reached peak insanity.

When a governor and attorney general (in this case, California Gov. Gavin Newsom) threatens law enforcement for cooperating with…

LAW ENFORCEMENT.

Meanwhile, the list of Americans killed by migrant criminal aliens, who should never have been here in the first place, keeps growing.

Homicidal Sanctuary City policies don’t protect the innocent.

They endanger us all.

🚨 Socialism is creeping into America, one city at a time.

Government-run grocery stores don’t create prosperity. 

They burn taxpayer dollars, crush competition, and deliver failure.

America was built on free enterprise, NOT government control.

Reject socialism. 
Defend freedom. 
Keep America free.

Ask a Democrat Socialist one simple question: 

“Where has socialism ever worked?” 

They will stand there speechless. 

No answers.
No examples.

Because socialism has failed everywhere it’s been tried: Venezuela, Cuba, the Soviet Union, and every other place it’s destroyed economies and crushed freedom. 

This country was built on freedom, capitalism, and individual liberty.

America works. 
Socialism doesn’t. 

End of discussion.

🚨Justice served for ANTIFA Domestic Terrorists.

Antifa radicals who opened fire on an ICE facility in Texas last year have been hit with more than 450 years in federal prison.

This is what happens when you declare war on the rule of law in America. These domestic terrorists tried to intimidate ICE agents doing their jobs, and now they will spend the rest of their lives behind bars where they belong.

For years, radical left-wing mobs have attacked police, ICE, and federal officers with zero consequences. 
No more. 

The Trump administration is restoring accountability.

All three Mamdani-backed candidates swept the NY primaries last night.

This should be a wake-up call to the Republican Party that we cannot simply denounce the socialist views of the radical left.

Republicans must unite and stand against ideas that will destroy this country. https://t.co/l3V4oCCD0Z

This is what radical indoctrination looks like in American schools.

5th graders in New York City were taught to pantomime getting shot by police in a so-called “talent show.” 

Kids collapsing on stage as if gunned down by law enforcement. 

This is not education. This is grooming children to hate the men and women who stand on a wall for our safety.

America’s classrooms should teach respect for law enforcement, not rehearse anti-police theater.

The radical left’s idea of Father’s Day: PRO TRANSGENDER BOOKS

While families across America celebrate dads, NYC schools and libraries chose to read transgender books to young children on a day meant to honor fathers.

They are erasing biological reality, undermining the nuclear family, and pushing gender confusion on kids who should be celebrating their fathers.

Turning something like “father’s day” into activist story time is an insult to every American family.

🚨 The New York Times spent Father’s Day celebrating “trans dads.”

Let that sink in.

A day meant to honor fathers, masculinity, and the men who sacrifice for their families was turned into another lesson in gender ideology.

Fatherhood is not a costume. Fatherhood is not a feeling. Fatherhood is not something you can identify into.

It’s earned through responsibility, sacrifice, protection, and love.

Children deserve truth, not confusion. 

They deserve strong role models, not activists trying to blur every line that has guided families for generations.

American taxpayers come first.

The DOJ just announced the largest healthcare fraud bust in U.S. history: 

Charging 324 defendants for schemes ripping off over $14.6 BILLION in taxpayer-funded programs.

Hundreds of fraudsters arrested. 
No more letting criminals loot Medicare and Medicaid.

President Trump is cracking down on waste, fraud, and abuse.

Yesterday, MLB Players faced backlash from the league for expressing their Christian beleifs.

Today, America is demanding answers for this selective “inclusion”.

While they bent over backwards for BLM messaging in 2020, they’re cracking down on religious freedom in 2026.

This isn’t neutrality, it’s political discrimination against faith. 

Americans see the double standard.

posts.text:
🚨NYC Mayor Mamdani is doubling down on abolishing ICE and pushing these radical sanctuary city policies.

While New Yorkers deal with the real-world consequences of illegal immigration’s, ICE is out there doing the job that weak politicians refuse to do. 

You don’t keep Americans safe by shielding criminal illegal aliens. 

You keep them safe by enforcing the law.

Common sense seems to be uncommon in these blue cities.

🚨BREAKING: The DOJ just charged 15 Violent ANTIFA members for their violent attacks on ICE facilities

These are not “peaceful protesters” they’re domestic terrorists who terrorized our law enforcement officers.

The message for these violent criminals: You attack America, you go to prison.

President Trump is fighting to keep our country safe by putting these animals behind bars where they belong.

Justice is finally being served.

Love your country? 
Expect criticism.

Push the latest woke cause? 
Expect applause.

That’s the double standard.

Patriotism gets treated like a problem. Woke activism gets treated like a virtue.

Americans are tired of being told the flag, faith, and love of country are offensive while every trendy political movement gets a standing ovation.

Americans have had ENOUGH.

5 in custody after an alleged drone plot on WH UFC Freedom 250 celebration. 

In moments like these, we're reminded of the importance of the men and women who stand watch to protect our communities and our nation. 

A huge thank you to all law enforcement officers, security personnel, and first responders whose dedication, vigilance, and sacrifice help keep Americans safe every day.

The View openly criticizes young men for turning to Christ.

America is a nation founded on faith and freedom. The next generation represents this country’s future. Their choice to follow Christ should not be ridiculed or mocked. It should be celebrated.

The radical left only supports the ideologies that serve their agenda.

Happy 251st birthday to the United States Army! 🇺🇸

For 251 years, generations of Soldiers have answered the call to defend and serve our nation, upholding the values that make America strong.

Today, we honor their courage, sacrifice, and unwavering dedication. https://t.co/x3OH8hQ7rd

Today we celebrate Flag Day, a symbol of unity, freedom, and the enduring ideals that bring Americans together.

This flag represents our nation's history and core values, and it continues to inspire generations of Americans.

May we always honor and stay committed to preserving the freedoms it symbolizes.

Happy Flag Day!

Congressman Wesley Hunt’s office was honored to participate alongside the CyFair Chamber in the grand opening and ribbon-cutting ceremony of the new Walk On’s Sports Bistreaux.

It is encouraging to see local partners collaborating to support new businesses. 

This opening represents an incredible achievement for Cypress, contributing to the local economy and generating employment opportunities within TX-38.

President Trump is delivering justice and protecting vulnerable children.

More than 150,000 migrant children were effectively lost in the CHAOS of the Biden border crisis, released to sponsors with inadequate oversight and left vulnerable to exploitation, trafficking, and abuse.

Now, those days are over.

The Trump Administration is locating missing children, strengthening sponsor vetting, and putting traffickers and their enablers on notice.

A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
